senses.gloss: सैंह saiṃha, n. (ī) belonging to a lion (siṃha), 🞄leonine.
सैंहल saiṃhala, a. relating to Ceylon, Singhalese.

सैंहिकेय saiṃhik-eya, a. descended from 🞄Siṃhikā;
 m. met. of Rāhu.

सैनिक sain-ika, a. relating or belonging to 🞄an army (senā);
 m. soldier: pl. troops.
सैन्दूर saindūra, a. coloured with vermilion 🞄(sindūra): ī-kṛ́, colour with red lead or vermilion.
